topic: How does the antenna's 52.9% axial ratio bandwidth impact link budget efficiency in variable orbital configurations?
consensus_response: The antenna's 52.9% axial ratio bandwidth introduces polarization mismatch, reducing signal coupling and increasing interference between beams in variable orbital configurations. This necessitates more robust beamforming algorithms that can adapt to varying polarization states, potentially increasing computational complexity and power consumption. Polarization mismatch reduces link budget efficiency by decreasing signal coupling and increasing interference between beams.
